start.speaker: Service Plate
start.text: Trim the wick. Align the lens. Bring the flame to the burner only when both are ready. The instructions are worn smooth where other keepers rested their hands.

wick.text: You trim the blackened wick until a clean edge remains. Paraffin catches the light on your fingers.

lens.text: The lens turns against its stops. You settle it into alignment with the north window.

not_ready.text: Not yet. Check the wick and align the lens before lighting the burner. The service plate will remind you.

relight.text: The wick takes. Gold rises through the glass, and the lens carries it out into the fog.

answer.text: Beyond the north rocks: three flashes, then dark. You keep your hand on the warm railing. Three flashes answer again.

contact.speaker: Radio - Tom Salish
contact.text: The radio below breaks the silence. "Marrow light? I can see you from here. Keep it steady. I am listening."

already_lit.text: The lamp holds its rhythm. Beyond the north rocks, the answering light waits between flashes.
